properties.displayName: UAV S16 - AOI Excursion (Unauthorized Area of Interest Departure)
properties.description: UAV가 AOI_Boundary_List에 정의된 임무구역을 이탈하고 최소속도 이상으로 비행 중 3회 이상 연속 이탈 이벤트 탐지. MITRE: T0835 Manipulate I/O Image / Collection
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 15m;
let minSpeed = toscalar(
    _GetWatchlist('UAV_Threshold_List')
    | where ThresholdKey == 'MinGroundspeed_ms'
    | project toreal(Value));
let AoiBounds = _GetWatchlist('AOI_Boundary_List') | project MissionId;
UAVTelemetry_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| where MsgType == 'GLOBAL_POSITION_INT'
| where Groundspeed > minSpeed
| join kind=leftanti (AoiBounds) on $left.MissionId == $right.MissionId
| summarize ExcursionCount=count(), FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated),
    MaxSpeed=max(Groundspeed)
    by UAVId, MissionId, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where ExcursionCount >= 3
| extend TriggerReason = strcat("AOI_이탈_", tostring(ExcursionCount), "회_MissionId_", MissionId)
| extend Severity = "Medium"
| project FirstSeen, UAVId, MissionId, ExcursionCount, MaxSpeed, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by FirstSeen desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S16 - AOI Excursion (Unauthorized Area of Interest Departure) - {{UAVId}}
